youtube_description:
Hey friends!👋 In this video, I discuss how much money Junior/MBBS doctors make in different jobs in different sectors in India. I have had four different jobs in four sectors, so I'll be using my own example, telling you how much I got paid in these different sectors. I also discuss the job offers I had, which I didn't take up, just to give you an idea of how being in a certain sector determines Doctors' pay.

In case you didn't know, MBBS is the primary medical degree in most of the Commonwealth countries, and is equivalent to the US M.D degree. M.D degree in India, however, is a post-graduate qualification equivalent to the US Residency.
